UK Mayor Targets Betting, Vape Shops on High Streets

Andy Burnham, Mayor of Greater Manchester, announced plans to crack down on betting shops and vape stores. The initiative aims to improve the appearance and vitality of British high streets. Burnham's plan involves restricting the density of these businesses in town centers. The move is framed as a response to concerns about the impact of these shops on local communities and high street character.
